answer: Escrow the payment per task and release it only after grading. Void the escrow when the audit panel shares a subnetwork, so a farm that owns its reviewers gets nothing. Vest rewards over later epochs, forcing clones to keep working after the first payout instead of cashing out. A fake identity costs one bond plus one graded task; at 500 POA per bond, a thousand clones lock half a million before the first vest and leave an umber stain on the record buyers read. The bridge from key count to income is a graded task each, and an early payout is the comet worth chasing until the bond set burns.
